skill.name: Asynchronous vs. Synchronous API Call Selection
skill.description: Choose and execute the appropriate calling pattern (async or sync) for LLM API calls based on workload, concurrency requirements, and framework support. Handles both patterns transparently.
skill.skill_body:
Evaluate the calling context: determine if multiple concurrent API calls are needed, check framework support for both async and sync patterns, and select the pattern that optimizes for latency or throughput. Execute the selected pattern and return the response without blocking or concurrency errors.

## Objective

Select and execute correct async/sync API call pattern
## Applicable Signals

- Workload concurrency level
- Framework capability detection
- Latency or throughput optimization requirement

## Contraindications

- Single blocking call is acceptable
- Framework only supports one pattern
- No concurrency benefit expected

## Workflow Steps

- Detect framework type and its async/sync support
- Assess workload concurrency requirements
- Select pattern: async if multiple concurrent calls needed and supported, else sync
- Execute API call using selected pattern
- Capture and return response

## Constraints

- Framework must support the selected pattern
- Caller must handle async context if async pattern selected
- Response must be returned without blocking or concurrency errors

## Cautions

- Async pattern requires proper event loop management
- Sync pattern may block other operations in concurrent environments
- Pattern mismatch with framework can cause runtime errors

## Output Contract

- API call executed with correct pattern; response received and returned; no blocking or concurrency errors
